title: [Koyu Booking Link] - Auth Trigger - Reserve Tapped While Logged Out - Login/Register Displayed
description: AC 01.3 - Permission Matrix - Auth gate is triggered at Reserve action boundary only, consistent with LT-94696 direct navigation intent.
preconditions:
- User is logged out.
- Booking link EM-1001 is valid and Event A is reservable.
- Related implementation: LT-94696 Handle Direct Navigation without login redirect.
steps_actions:
1. Open booking link and enter Event A detail page.
2. Interact with non-reserve detail content (scroll/read).
3. Tap Reserve button.
steps_result:
1. Event detail opens in pre-login mode.
2. No login/register redirect appears during non-reserve interactions.
3. Login/Register gate appears and keeps Event A context for continuation.
steps_data:
1. event = Event A
2. interaction_scope = non_reserve_only
3. auth_trigger = reserve_button_tap; expected_context = Event A
suite: LT-94694 - Reserve Auth Trigger and Continuation

title: [Koyu Booking Link] - Login Continuation - Logged Out Reserve Flow - Booking Continues After Login
description: AC 01.4 - State Transition Testing - After Login from Reserve, flow returns to same event and reaches booking verified screen.
preconditions:
- Start from Event A detail in logged-out booking-link flow.
- Valid account User S1 exists and can sign in.
- Related implementation: LT-94695 review current event page flow.
steps_actions:
1. Tap Reserve on Event A detail.
2. Choose Login and sign in with User S1.
3. Proceed with booking after return.
steps_result:
1. Login or Register choices are shown as auth gate.
2. Authentication succeeds and flow returns to Event A booking context.
3. Booking verified screen is reached for Event A.
steps_data:
1. event = Event A; trigger = reserve_button
2. auth_path = login; user = S1
3. expected_post_auth = booking_verified; expected_context = Event A
suite: LT-94694 - Reserve Auth Trigger and Continuation

title: [Koyu Booking Link] - Register Continuation - New User Reserve Flow - Booking Continues After Registration
description: AC 01.4 - Scenario Testing - Register path preserves selected event context and continues booking flow (including register-info UI).
preconditions:
- Start from Event B detail in logged-out booking-link flow.
- New profile P1 is eligible for registration.
- Related implementation: LT-99387 improve login flow UI.
steps_actions:
1. Tap Reserve on Event B detail.
2. Choose Register and complete required register information for P1.
3. Continue booking immediately after register completion.
steps_result:
1. Auth screen with Register path is shown.
2. Registration succeeds and user becomes authenticated.
3. Flow resumes with Event B context and proceeds to booking verified or next booking step.
steps_data:
1. event = Event B; trigger = reserve_button
2. auth_path = register; profile = P1_new
3. expected_context = Event B; expected_post_auth = booking_verified_or_next
suite: LT-94694 - Reserve Auth Trigger and Continuation
